card.name: Inside words ending in -ility or -ality
card.fires_on: The word piece just before an ending like -ility, -ality or -ities, in the middle of a longer noun. Seen in words like availability, possibility, mortality, suicidality, flexibility and quantities.

modes.label: Before -ility
modes.description: Middle piece of a noun that will end in -ility, often misspelled or split oddly.
modes.example: In managing overdosage, consider the poss<<ibi>>ity of multiple drug overdoses

modes.label: Before -ality
modes.description: Middle piece of a noun that will end in -ality, such as mortality or suicidality, often in capitalized warnings.
modes.example: WARNING: ALL-CAUSE M<<ORT>>ALITY An increase in all-cause

modes.label: Before -ities
modes.description: Piece of the word quantities just before its ending.
modes.example: When ingested in certain<< quat>>ities, this toxin can cause harm -

card.writes: It suppresses noun endings like -ality, -ness and -ity, so the word is not finished a second time.
card.plain: It fires inside a long noun that is about to end in -ility or -ality, such as possibility or mortality.
